mapper.sql: select t.*, o.order_no as order_no, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, w.warehouse_name as warehouse_name from erp_receipt t left join erp_purchase_order o on o.id = t.order_id left join erp_supplier s on s.id = o.supplier_id left join erp_warehouse w on w.id = t.warehouse_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_receipt (receipt_no, order_id, warehouse_id, receipt_date, quality_note, receipt_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, idempotency_key, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{receiptNo}, #{orderId}, #{warehouseId}, #{receiptDate}, #{qualityNote}, #{receiptStatus}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedTime}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_receipt where id in #{id}
